cut.cm-09-factory-supervisor-ai: Fired in 92% of trials but worth nothing measurable: three worker-free factories a colony are noise beside hundreds, and it blurs the Robotic Controls line.
cut.cm-14-quantum-encryption: Fired in 2% of trials. The AI rarely spies at that stage, so better counter-espionage almost never matters.
cut.cm-19-universal-translator: No measurable value, and its goodwill half duplicates Holovision Broadcast Network.
cut.cn-19-damage-control-teams: A near-copy of the classic Automated Repair System, with no measurable value.
cut.ff-11-shield-capacitors: Never fired: early AI designs carry no deflectors, so there was nothing to strengthen. Absorption Lattice keeps the idea later.
cut.ff-23-flux-shields: +1 beam defence is the weakest combat effect calibrated (about 5% more ships) and showed no value in trials.
cut.ff-28-structural-integrity-fields: Slightly negative in trials; +15% hit points is worth only about 6% more ships.
cut.ff-33-phase-barrier: Never fired, and the combat calibration found +5 planetary-shield absorption worth nothing.
cut.ff-35-gravitic-lensing-array: Never fired: a longer scanner range changes nothing the AI does.
cut.pl-19-bio-engineered-soil: Fired in 12% of trials with no measurable value: few soil projects are left when it arrives.
cut.pl-29-planetary-disaster-response: Random disasters are too rare to matter (17% of trials, no measurable value).
cut.pl-37-bio-containment-fields: Bio-weapons and plague are too rare to matter (9% of trials, no measurable value).
cut.pr-13-assault-shuttles: A weaker duplicate of Stealth Landing Craft (the same effect), active in 9% of trials.
cut.pr-17-hyperspace-trade-lanes: Fired in 14% of trials with no measurable value: trade agreements mature anyway.
cut.pr-49-hyperwarp-overdrive: Harmful in AI hands: +2 warp hurried its holder into wars it lost (fleet -53%, empire power -6%).

pl-19-gaia-seeding.why: At level 39 almost no new normal colonies are founded (9% of trials fired).

pl-39-hyper-fertility-treatments.why: Its old tier holds one swappable classic tech, Terraforming +100, which it halved. Level 39 shares a tier with three.

pr-13-navigation-beacons.why: Propulsion tier 2 held two new techs and cut Nuclear Engines and Irridium Fuel Cells from 57% to 34% of trees.

pr-17-emergency-warp-capacitors.why: Propulsion tier 6 held two new techs. Tier 4 has four classic techs to share the slots with.

pr-44-slipstream-drives.why: As first designed it hurt AI holders (−4.7% empire power, the whole interval below zero): they fought fewer battles but lost a third more ships. Now it speeds only fleets bound for your own colonies, and re-tests at −1.3% (−4.9% to +2.2%), inside the range of the classic engine techs.
